ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions are printed in full where the website draft had shortened them: «Из браминского закона Ману» ('From the Brahmanic law of Manu') and «Буддийская мудрость. Дхаммапада» ('Buddhist wisdom. Dhammapada'); «Магомет» is Muhammad. «Человекоубийство» (chelovekoubiystvo, literally 'man-killing') is rendered 'the killing of people', and «бессловесные» (besslovesnye, 'the speechless ones') 'the dumb creatures'.
